appliedUpdates.description: Committed .factory/library/wiremock-oauth2.md to git. The file documents WireMock Spring Boot integration patterns for OAuth2 testing: dependency, usage pattern, key architecture note (OAuth2ClientConfig builds ClientRegistration programmatically), stub patterns for Google OIDC and GitHub OAuth2, and state parameter handling approach.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance on the '@Bean(distinct-name) + @Primary' pattern for test bean overrides. When a test needs to override a production Spring bean (e.g., ClientRegistrationRepository), use @TestConfiguration with @Bean("distinct-name") @Primary rather than matching the production bean method name. Example: WireMockOAuth2TestConfig overrides clientRegistrationRepository with @Bean("wireMockClientRegistrationRepository") @Primary to redirect all OAuth URLs to WireMock.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature wiremock-oauth2-tests used this pattern in WireMockOAuth2TestConfig.java:23-24. The pattern is non-obvious and undiscoverable from existing code without context.
